# agentic-prd

> Comment-pin + PRD overlay widget for React apps, a dev-only Vite sidecar exposing them over a local HTTP API (local JSON storage, no backend), and a Claude Code plugin so coding agents can act on in-app feedback.

## Docs

- [Install guide for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeJee/agentic-prd/main/llms-install.md): step-by-step install with success criteria
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeJee/agentic-prd/main/README.md): overview, quickstart, the loop
- [Contributor/agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeJee/agentic-prd/main/AGENTS.md): architecture, commands, pitfalls
- [Widget package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeJee/agentic-prd/main/packages/widget/README.md): @agentic-prd/widget API
- [Dev plugin package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeJee/agentic-prd/main/packages/dev-plugin/README.md): @agentic-prd/dev-plugin API
